variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.body: A company has laid off many workers in {colony}. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company
variants.body: Many workers have been laid off by a company in the colony. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.body: The colony has seen a company carry out a large layoff. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
